Description.description:
Version Control:
Versioning of the solution should conform to the following standards:
MajorVersion.Release.Sprint.Build
Major Version: Major version to denote large changes in functionality and/or compatibility with future/previous versions
Release: Current working release number
Sprint: Sprint number of the current working sprint
Build: Build number of the current configuration.
This is the default publisher used for Skills Funding Agency
